story.title: Mark Zuckerberg attacks 'closed' AI rivals as Meta returns to open models

draft:
Mark Zuckerberg is taking a swing at closed AI systems, pushing Meta back towards open models. 
I think this shift is driven by the need for transparency and accountability in AI development. 
Meta's approach may foster collaboration and drive innovation, but it also raises concerns about data privacy and security. 
What are the implications of this move for the future of AI development?
#AI #Meta #OpenSource
